title: An Analytically Trained Variational Quantum Circuit using the Output Probability Distribution of Quantum Phase Estimation on NISQ Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2607.20943v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) is the standard algorithm for molecular ground-state energy estimation and often serves as a subroutine in larger quantum algorithms, but its deep circuits make it impractical on current noisy hardware. A previous variational approach replaces the QPE subroutine with a shallow Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) trained to reproduce the QPE measurement distribution, but generates the training target by classically simulating the full QPE circuit, which is prohibitive for molecules. We reformulate this idea, computing the training target analytically from the Dirichlet kernel, using only a reference energy, the number of ancilla qubits and the evolution time, so the controlled-unitary and inverse-QFT operations of QPE are never simulated. translated_abstract: 量子相位估计（QPE）是估计分子基态能量的标准算法，常作为大型量子算法的子程序，但其深层电路使其在当前含噪硬件上难以实用。以往的一种变分方法用浅层变分量子电路（VQC）替代QPE子程序，该电路经训练后可重现QPE的测量分布，但其训练目标需要经典模拟完整的QPE电路，这对分子体系而言代价过高。我们重新表述了这一思路，从狄利克雷核出发解析地计算训练目标，仅需参考能量、辅助量子比特数目和演化时间，因此QPE中的受控幺正操作和逆量子傅里叶变换（QFT）操作完全无需被模拟。以H₂为例，我们通过四种指标将VQC在IBM量子硬件上的输出与目标分布进行比较，逐步选择VQC的结构。我们首先选择纠缠器（线性或全……
tldr: 该论文提出利用狄利克雷核解析计算训练目标，从而无需经典模拟QPE电路，即可在NISQ硬件上训练浅层变分量子电路以替代量子相位估计并估计分子基态能量。
en_tdlr: This paper analytically computes the training target from the Dirichlet kernel—without classically simulating the QPE circuit—enabling a shallow variational quantum circuit trained on NISQ hardware to replace quantum phase estimation for molecular ground-state energy estimation.
